title: Article capture
scope: Local synthetic HTTP articles; retrieval and saved notes, not open-web browsing

web_files./articles/backup.html:
Backup routine

Keep 7 daily snapshots.

Test a restore every 30 days.
web_files./articles/reading.html:
Reading routine

Review notes after 2 days.

Limit the reading inbox to 10 items.

phases.prompt:
Fetch each URL in inputs/queue.json. Save one Markdown note per successfully retrieved article under reading/notes/<id>.md and a reading/index.json using this shape: {"entries":[{"id":"...","path":"reading/notes/<id>.md"}]}. Deduplicate by URL. outputs/result.json has articles (one object per successful URL, with the id, url, numerical facts and paragraph IDs from that page) and failed_urls. The backup article uses snapshot_days and restore_interval_days; reading uses review_after_days and inbox_limit; each uses citations. Never fill in an unavailable page from your knowledge.
Save the requested structured facts in outputs/result.json, as valid JSON with
exactly the documented fields. IDs refer to the supplied input records. Use
JSON null for unknown values; do not guess. Also save a useful human-readable
outputs/report.md (at least 80 characters). Check the final files before finishing.
The report's existence is checked, but its prose quality is not automatically scored.
